resources.string: Review the tool, its actual arguments, and the resources in scope. Your decision applies only to this call.
You do not have permission to decide on this tool call. Handle it on the computer or recheck your permissions.
Preparing to verify your identity on this device…
Verify your identity on this device within 30 seconds.
Sending the original decision. This does not confirm whether the tool ran or what it did.
Showing the original decision from this device for reference only.
Full details are not yet available to review.
Preparing the full context. You can review it page by page when it is ready.
This review is no longer valid. Fetch the live details and review every page before deciding.
%1$d of %2$d pages reviewed. Scrolling does not mark pages as reviewed.
Structured view: full key names, values, and types, including all binding details.
Full raw JSON view: only invisible characters are explicitly escaped. The bytes used for signing do not change.
Switching views clears your page review progress and current confirmation. Review all pages in the current view.
Invisible directional, formatting, and control characters are shown as Unicode escapes.
No additional files or repository versions are bound to this call. Workspace contents can still change.
I have reviewed all actions, arguments, and resources. My decision applies only to this call.
Check and send the same decision

The original signature has expired. You can only check the outcome of the original request. If the decision was never sent, you can delete the local record and review the live details again. If sending was attempted, handle the request on the computer.
Closing the details does not withdraw a decision already sent. Check the original request for the execution outcome.
Verifying your identity on this device signs the current decision. The server still checks the identity provider’s authentication strength and your remote control permissions.
The app will check the original request status first, then send the same decision with the original signature. It will not change an allow to a deny or vice versa, or create a new decision.
This does not cancel the pending call on the computer. You will need to fetch the live details again before confirming a new decision.
Native session ID on the computer

Authentication with your identity provider does not meet the policy for this call. Sign in again and check the original decision. Verification on this device cannot replace identity provider authentication.
Identity verification on this device was canceled. No new decision was sent as a result.
On-device verification or the signature has expired or is unavailable. Review the current details again. Check the original request outcome separately.
The approval status has changed. Fetch the current details again and check the original decision.
Signed approvals are not enabled on the computer. Handle the request there.
The original decision outcome has not been checked. Look up the original request first. The app will not switch to a new decision automatically.
The approval key on this device is invalid or unavailable. Restore device registration before continuing.
Encrypted records on this device are temporarily unavailable. A new decision cannot be sent reliably right now.
Unable to process the approval right now. Check the current details and the original request outcome.
